articles.summary: Everus Construction Group (NYSE: ECG) today reported financial results for third quarter 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Summary (All comparisons versus the prior-year period unless otherwise noted, and results denoted with * are quarterly records.) Revenues of $1.38 billion*, up 40.3%. Net income of $91.9 million*, up 61.2%; net income margin of 6.6%. Diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $1.79*, up 61.3%. Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) of $140.2 million*, up 57.5%; EBITDA margin of 10.1%. Backlog of $5.48 billion*, up 69.8% from Dec. 31, 2025, and up 86.1% from Sept. 30, 2025. Net leverage of 0.7x. On Sept. 1, 2026, Everus completed the acquisition of Epsilon Industries. See the Non-GAAP Measures sections for definitions and reconciliations of the non-GAAP financial measures used in this news release.
